title: Topic 5.4: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse

pages.lesson:
LESSON: ALCOHOL, DRUGS AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.4: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do young people abuse alcohol and drugs?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ALCOHOL, DRUGS AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE
This lesson teaches Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse for Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse above.
2. Explain Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do young people abuse alcohol and drugs?
2. How can you avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
